name: adwhispr-ads
description: Research competitor ads and launch or manage advertising campaigns through AdWhispr.

interface.longDescription: Research competitor ads and launch and manage campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, X Ads, Reddit Ads, and ChatGPT Ads. Discover active advertisers, analyze Facebook and Instagram ads, organic posts, paid partnerships, creators, and TikTok content, compare brands, identify hooks and creative patterns, generate competitive briefs, and discover keywords. Connect your advertising accounts to launch and manage image, carousel, video, search, YouTube, Shopping, Performance Max, and chat-card campaigns; research targeting; create custom and lookalike audiences; inspect account delivery; review performance; edit locations, keywords, bids, campaign names, and budgets; and pause or resume campaigns. Campaigns are created paused, and nothing spends until you confirm.

positive.description: View Correxiko's longest-running active Meta ads with inline creatives.
positive.prompt: Use AdWhispr to show me Correxiko's five longest-running active Meta ads.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns five active Correxiko Meta ads ordered longest-running first, including days running, available ad details, and inline creative media.

positive.description: Summarize Correxiko's current advertising activity and leading creative hooks.
positive.prompt: Use AdWhispr to summarize Correxiko's current advertising activity and list its top hooks.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Correxiko and returns current active and total ad counts, creative-format distribution, and leading hooks without inventing CTR, conversions, or ROAS.

positive.description: Find verified advertisers currently running ads in Correxiko's market.
positive.prompt: Use AdWhispr to show me competitors currently running ads in Correxiko's market.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the saved Correxiko business profile and returns relevant advertisers verified to be running ads with active-ad counts, while clearly separating any unverified suggestions.

positive.description: Research Absolute Collagen's TikTok ads with inline creatives.
positive.prompt: Use AdWhispr to show me TikTok ads for Absolute Collagen.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns available Absolute Collagen ads from TikTok's public Commercial Content Library, including available dates, audience ranges, creative classifications, and inline media.

positive.description: Research Google Search keyword demand and estimated click costs for marine collagen.
positive.prompt: Use AdWhispr to research keywords for marine collagen.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns relevant keyword ideas with monthly search volume, competition level, and top-of-page CPC ranges without inventing CTR, conversion rates, or ROAS.

negative.description: Logo and brand-identity design is outside AdWhispr's advertising research and campaign capabilities.
negative.prompt: Design a complete logo and full brand identity for my new company.

negative.description: Organic social publishing is outside AdWhispr's advertising campaign tools.
negative.prompt: Write and post an Instagram caption to my feed for today.

negative.description: A general SEO audit is outside AdWhispr's advertising research and execution scope.
negative.prompt: Audit my website's SEO and suggest better meta tags.

publication.release_notes: Updated the five reviewer test cases to use the prepared Correxiko demo account, verified Meta and TikTok creative workflows, competitor discovery, and marine-collagen keyword research. The existing listing metadata, production MCP connection, and three negative test cases are unchanged.
